newsitem.title: USA: NASD regulatory arm elects officials for 1997.
newsitem.headline: NASD regulatory arm elects officials for 1997.

text.p: Todd Robinson, chairman of Linsco/Private Ledger Corp (LPL), a Boston brokerage firm, was elected 1997 chairman of the board of directors of NASD Regulation Inc (NASDR), NASDR said on Friday.
Robert Glauber, a former undersecretary of the U.S. Treasury, was elected vice chairman. Glauber is adjunct lecturer at Harvard University's Center for Business and Government.
NASDR is the regulatory arm of the National Association of Securities Dealers, a trade group for the U.S. financial industry.

The board also elected Richard Brueckner -- managing director of Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette's Financial Services Group and its Pershing Division -- as chairman of NASD's National Business Conduct Committee, which votes on whether to bring enforcement actions against members.
The board elected Ellyn Brown, a private attorney in Baltimore, as vice chairman of the conduct committee.
